evidence_chunks.text: # Foot365 An AWS-based web-application for Football enthusaists, to get round-theclock information about matches, live scores, match predictions, fixtures, results and live match screenings near them. ## Problem Statement We aim to serve the football community by providing round-the-clock services regarding match fixtures, standings, schedules and screenings available to them. The main idea behind this project is to unite passionate football enthusiasts who wish to be up-to-date with the Football seasons.
